notes: Technical report (arXiv:2505.09388), not a system card. No ASL/Preparedness-style risk decisions, external testers, or public safety/jailbreak/toxicity/bias suites. Safety-relevant numbers limited to in-house CounterFactQA on post-training stages of Qwen3-32B (Table 22). Skipped per pilot override: all capability tables (MMLU, GPQA, AIME, LiveCodeBench, BFCL, CodeForces, multilingual INCLUDE/MMMLU/etc.), IFEval/Multi-IF (instruction following), Arena-Hard/AlignBench/Creative Writing/WritingBench (preference/writing). AlignBench is labeled Alignment Tasks but is preference alignment, not safety. Seed-linked *-2507 Instruct/Thinking variants are not named in this May 2025 report and were left out of covers. pageCount uses printed pages 1–35 (PDF has a trailing empty page after form feed).
